merge_basis: Both items concern Zongertinib in 1L NSCLC and its NDA/approval timeline in China; G0003 tracks the CFDI inspection outcome pending mid-February 2026, while T0012 covers the rolling submission of 12-month updated data to CDE around January 2026 — both are milestones in the same 1L NSCLC accelerated approval pathway (Beamion LUNG-1, 1479-0001).
